title: Morningstar SunSaver MPPT (SS-MPPT-15L)
source: Morningstar SunSaver MPPT MODBUS Specification v11, 3 April 2017
verifiedBy: TankAlarm bench unit (SS-MPPT-15L via MRC-1): addresses 0x0008-0x000C answered on 2026-04-22 and 2026-07-03. Nothing else is confirmed on hardware yet.
notes: Registers marked ~ come from the Morningstar specification and have not been confirmed on our bench.

The voltage scales are unsettled: the specification gives n*100/32768 for every voltage except Vb_ref (n*96.667/32768), while the TankAlarm client scales 0x0008-0x000A by 96.667. Run 'scalecheck' before trusting or writing a voltage.

Voltages have three scales here so that each can be corrected alone: vlive for what the controller measures, vset for the settings it stores and for va_ref_fixed, its start-up copy of one, vref for Vb_ref. A controller could use one figure for measurements and another for settings.
The limits on writable settings are OptaView sanity limits for 12 V setpoints, not Morningstar's own limits.

Left out on purpose: the lighting coil (the specification prints address 0x0020 with logical number 27, which disagree) and the logged data block at 0x8000 (the specification's record layout overlaps itself).
writeNotes: Every EEPROM write raises the controller's 'EEPROM setting edit' fault until the controller is reset. The specification does not say whether charging or the load output stop in that state.
Power this Opta from the battery, not from the SunSaver LOAD terminals, while changing settings.
Custom charge settings apply only with DIP switch 1 ON (the battery jumper picks bank 1 or 2). Custom LVD and LVR apply only with DIP switch 2 ON.
wiring: Wiring to a Morningstar MRC-1 (MeterBus to RS-485 adapter):
Opta A    to  MRC-1 terminal B   (crossed on purpose: Morningstar's A is the
Opta B    to  MRC-1 terminal A    inverting line, the Opta's A is not)
Opta GND  to  MRC-1 terminal G
1. The MRC-1 power switch is ON. Its LED is solid green either way.
2. The RJ-11 cable is fully seated at both ends; the MRC-1 is powered through it.
3. The SunSaver's DIP switch 4 selects MODBUS, not MeterBus.
4. Link settings are 9600 baud, 8N2, slave 1 ('probe' tries these first).
The MRC-1 LED while OptaView is asking ('watch' asks every few seconds):
off                 no power from the SunSaver: check the RJ-11 cable
steady green        the adapter sees no traffic: check its switch, then A, B and GND
flickers each time  the requests are reaching the adapter

registers.name: hourmeter
registers.label: Hourmeter
registers.note: The specification's worked example puts the LO word first; the register table (used here) puts HI first.

registers.name: alarm
registers.label: Alarms
registers.note: The specification does not say how the 24 alarm bits split across the HI and LO words; bit 0 is taken as the lowest bit of the LO word.

registers.name: lighting_should_be_on
registers.label: Lighting output wanted
registers.note: Controller firmware v08 and later.

registers.name: va_ref_fixed
registers.label: Fixed array voltage target (0 = none)
registers.note: Controller firmware v08 and later. The controller copies EVa_ref_fixed_init here at start-up, as it is, so this is on the scale of the stored settings. Not 0: MPPT sweeping and tracking stop, and the array is held at this voltage.

registers.name: va_ref_fixed_pct
registers.label: Fixed array target, percent of Voc
registers.note: Controller firmware v08 and later. The controller copies EVa_ref_fixed_pct_init here at start-up.

registers.name: EV_float
registers.label: Float voltage at 25 C (0 = no float)

registers.name: Et_floatlb
registers.label: Absorption time before float after a low battery

registers.name: EV_floatlb_trip
registers.label: Low-battery voltage that selects the longer absorption

registers.name: Et_float_exit_cum
registers.label: Time below float that exits float
registers.note: The specification's table gives seconds; its description block says volts.

registers.name: EV_eq
registers.label: Equalize voltage at 25 C (0 = no equalize)

registers.name: Et_eq_above
registers.label: Equalize time limit above the absorption voltage

registers.name: Et_eq_reg
registers.label: Equalize time limit at the equalize voltage

registers.name: EV_float2
registers.label: Float voltage at 25 C (0 = no float)

registers.name: Et_floatlb2
registers.label: Absorption time before float after a low battery

registers.name: EV_floatlb_trip2
registers.label: Low-battery voltage that selects the longer absorption

registers.name: Et_float_exit_cum2
registers.label: Time below float that exits float
registers.note: The specification's table gives seconds; its description block says volts.

registers.name: EV_eq2
registers.label: Equalize voltage at 25 C (0 = no equalize)

registers.name: Et_eq_above2
registers.label: Equalize time limit above the absorption voltage

registers.name: Et_eq_reg2
registers.label: Equalize time limit at the equalize voltage

registers.name: EV_tempcomp
registers.label: Temperature compensation per C (0 = off)
registers.note: Only the low byte is used and the sign is implied negative: write a positive value. OptaView reads only the low byte, and writes 0 in the high byte.

registers.name: EV_hvd
registers.label: Battery high voltage disconnect at 25 C (0 = off)

registers.name: EV_hvr
registers.label: Battery high voltage reconnect
registers.note: 0 does not switch it off: the battery never falls to 0 V, so after a high voltage disconnect charging would not come back. 0 in EV_hvd switches the disconnect off.

registers.name: ETb_max
registers.label: Highest temperature used for compensation
registers.note: Read-only in this profile: how the controller stores a negative limit is not confirmed.

registers.name: ETb_min
registers.label: Lowest temperature used for compensation
registers.note: The specification's description calls this a maximum too; taken as the minimum from its name. Read-only in this profile.

registers.name: EV_lvd
registers.label: Low voltage disconnect
registers.note: When ER_icomp is not 0, the controller lowers it in proportion to the load current; V_lvd shows the LVD in effect.

registers.name: EV_lhvr
registers.label: Load high voltage reconnect
registers.note: 0 does not switch it off: the battery never falls to 0 V, so after a load high voltage disconnect the load would not come back. 0 in EV_lhvd switches the disconnect off.

registers.name: ER_icomp
registers.label: Load current compensation of the LVD and LED thresholds (0 = off)
registers.note: It lowers the LVD in proportion to the load current, so that a battery under load is not disconnected too early; V_lvd shows the LVD in effect. The specification says the LED thresholds are compensated the same way, without saying how. Its table gives ohms; its description block says V/A (the same thing).

registers.name: Et_lvd_warn
registers.label: LVD warning time
registers.note: How long the load stays on after the battery has fallen to the LVD, before it is disconnected.

registers.name: EV_soc_y2g
registers.label: LED yellow to green (rising)
registers.note: When ER_icomp is not 0, the controller also compensates the LED thresholds for load current, as it does the LVD (the specification does not say how).

registers.name: EV_soc_g2y
registers.label: LED green to yellow (falling)
registers.note: When ER_icomp is not 0, the controller also compensates the LED thresholds for load current, as it does the LVD (the specification does not say how).

registers.name: EV_soc_y2r0
registers.label: LED yellow to blinking red (falling)
registers.note: When ER_icomp is not 0, the controller also compensates the LED thresholds for load current, as it does the LVD (the specification does not say how).

registers.name: EV_soc_r2y
registers.label: LED red to yellow (rising)
registers.note: When ER_icomp is not 0, the controller also compensates the LED thresholds for load current, as it does the LVD (the specification does not say how).

registers.name: Emodbus_id
registers.label: MODBUS slave address
registers.note: Read-only in this profile: a wrong value makes the controller unreachable.

registers.name: Emeter_id
registers.label: MeterBus address
registers.note: Read-only in this profile: Morningstar warns against changing it.

registers.name: EVa_ref_fixed_init
registers.label: Fixed array voltage target at start-up (0 = none)
registers.note: Controller firmware v08 and later. Copied to va_ref_fixed at start-up: not 0 stops MPPT sweeping and tracking, and the array is held at this voltage. Read-only in this profile.

registers.name: EVa_ref_fixed_pct_init
registers.label: Fixed array target at start-up, percent of Voc
registers.note: Controller firmware v08 and later. Copied to va_ref_fixed_pct at start-up. EVa_ref_fixed_init overrides it when that is not 0. Read-only in this profile.

registers.name: Eic_lim
registers.label: Charge current limit
registers.note: Read-only in this profile.

coils.name: equalize
coils.label: Equalize triggered
coils.note: Once the equalize is done, the controller resets the equalize calendar: the days to the next one count from then.

coils.name: clear_ah_resettable
coils.label: Clear the resettable Ah counters
coils.note: It also sets vb_min and vb_max, the lowest and highest battery voltage since the last reset, to the battery voltage now.

coils.name: clear_ah_total
coils.label: Clear the total Ah counters
coils.note: It also sets vb_min and vb_max, the lowest and highest battery voltage since the last reset, to the battery voltage now.

coils.name: clear_kwh
coils.label: Clear the kWh counter
coils.note: It also sets vb_min and vb_max, the lowest and highest battery voltage since the last reset, to the battery voltage now.

coils.name: force_eeprom_update
coils.label: Store the running totals in EEPROM now

checks.message: Low voltage reconnect (EV_lvr) must be above low voltage disconnect (EV_lvd).
Battery high voltage reconnect (EV_hvr) must be below high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
Load high voltage reconnect (EV_lhvr) must be below load high voltage disconnect (EV_lhvd).
Absorption voltage (EV_reg) must be below battery high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
Float voltage (EV_float) must be below battery high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
Equalize voltage (EV_eq) must be below battery high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
Bank 2 absorption voltage (EV_reg2) must be below battery high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
Bank 2 float voltage (EV_float2) must be below battery high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
Bank 2 equalize voltage (EV_eq2) must be below battery high voltage disconnect (EV_hvd).
LED yellow to green (EV_soc_y2g) must be above LED green to yellow (EV_soc_g2y), or the battery LED can flicker between the two.
LED red to yellow (EV_soc_r2y) must be above LED yellow to blinking red (EV_soc_y2r0), or the battery LED can flicker between the two.
LED yellow to blinking red (EV_soc_y2r0) must be below LED green to yellow (EV_soc_g2y), or a falling battery skips yellow.
LED red to yellow (EV_soc_r2y) must be below LED yellow to green (EV_soc_y2g), or a rising battery skips yellow.
